title: Feature Pool Element
description: Pool element that places a Feature (from the Features Reference) as part of a Jigsaw Structure, instead of placing a structure template. Useful for inserting procedurally generated decorations such as trees, plants, or ore patches into jigsaw layouts.

fields.title: Element Type
fields.description: Must be 'minecraft:feature_pool_element' for this element variant.

fields.title: Feature
fields.description: Identifier of the Feature to place when this element is chosen. Example: 'minecraft:eyeblossom_feature'.

fields.title: Projection
fields.description: How the feature projects onto terrain.
